theorems.informal_statement: For every real phase table φ : {L,R}×{L,R} → ℝ there is exactly one (α,β,γ,δ) ∈ ℝ⁴ with φ_ij = α + β z_i + γ z_j + δ z_i z_j for all i,j, where z_L = 1, z_R = −1.
If φ_ij = α + β z_i + γ z_j + δ z_i z_j for all i,j then 4δ = φ_LL + φ_RR − φ_LR − φ_RL (= Δφ).
The unique coefficients equal the closed forms used in decompose_phases: α = Σφ/4, β = (φLL+φLR−φRL−φRR)/4, γ = (φLL−φLR+φRL−φRR)/4, δ = Δφ/4.
Δφ is invariant under adding arbitrary local phases a_i + b_j to the table (only δ is entangling).
For real 3-vectors a, b with ‖a‖² ≤ 1, ‖b‖² ≤ 1: a_x b_x + a_y b_z + a_z b_y ≤ 1.
Sign variant: a_x b_x − a_y b_z − a_z b_y ≤ 1 under the same hypotheses.
Convexity: for weights w_k ≥ 0 with Σw_k = 1 and Bloch vectors a_k, b_k in the unit ball, Σ_k w_k (a_k,x b_k,x + s(a_k,y b_k,z + a_k,z b_k,y)) ≤ 1 for s = ±1.
assumptions: all a_k, b_k in the closed unit ball

theorems.informal_statement: Every 2×2 complex density matrix (PSD, trace 1) has Bloch vector r_i = Re tr(ρσ_i) with r_x²+r_y²+r_z² ≤ 1.
For density matrices ρA, ρB and W_s = 1⊗1 − X⊗X − s(Y⊗Z + Z⊗Y), s = ±1: Re tr((ρA⊗ρB) W_s) ≥ 0.
assumptions: ρA, ρB PSD with unit trace

theorems.informal_statement: For every separable two-qubit state ρ = Σ_k w_k ρA_k ⊗ ρB_k (finite sum, w_k ≥ 0, all factors density matrices): Re tr(ρ W_s) ≥ 0 for s = ±1. Hence a negative CPK witness value certifies entanglement.
assumptions: ρA_k, ρB_k PSD with unit trace

theorems.informal_statement: U(r) = −G mA mB / r < 0 for r > 0.
|U(r)| ≤ G mA mB / r_min for all r ≥ r_min > 0.
On the admissible domain r ≥ r_min > 0: −G mA mB / r_min ≤ U(r) < 0 (finite, negative, uniformly bounded).
The static branch phase φ = −U t/ħ satisfies 0 ≤ φ ≤ G mA mB t/(ħ r_min) for r ≥ r_min > 0, t ≥ 0.
If each branch phase lies in [0, B] then |Δφ| ≤ 2B.
Point singularity: for every M and every ε > 0 there is 0 < r < ε with U(r) < −M (unbounded below near 0⁺).
Point singularity (filter form): U(r) → −∞ as r → 0⁺.

The dephased BMV state ρ_{ij,kl} = ¼ e^{i(φ_ij−φ_kl)} e^{−x_A[i≠k] − x_B[j≠l]} is positive semidefinite for all real phases and x_A, x_B ≥ 0 (proof: ρ = (uu†) ∘ (D_A ⊗ D_B), Kronecker and Schur products of PSD matrices).
The dephased BMV state is Hermitian.
tr ρ = 1.
With constant rates (x = Γ t), Γ_A, Γ_B ≥ 0 and t ≥ 0, ρ is a density matrix: PSD, Hermitian, unit trace.
For |ψ⟩ with amplitudes e^{iφ_ij}/2, the Wootters pure-state concurrence |⟨ψ|σy⊗σy|ψ*⟩| equals |sin(Δφ/2)|, Δφ = φLL+φRR−φLR−φRL (= 4δ).
For d ≥ 2R > 0: E_Δ = G m²(6/(5R) − 1/d) satisfies 0 < E_Δ < 6Gm²/(5R).
assumptions: E_Δ is taken in its closed form for non-overlapping displacement (the overlap integral of sphere_mutual_energy is not formalised)

theorems.informal_statement: E_Δ is non-decreasing in d on d ≥ 2R.
Γ_DP = κ E_Δ/ħ satisfies 0 < Γ_DP < 6κGm²/(5Rħ) (finite, strictly positive collapse rate).
The ratio (23ħcR⁶cm²/(4πr⁷)) / (Gm²/r) is strictly decreasing in r on (0, ∞).
For target T > 0 and r_min > 0 with r_min⁶ = 23ħcR⁶cm²/(4πGm²T): for all r > 0, ratio(r) ≤ T ⇔ r ≥ r_min.
There is exactly one r_min > 0 with r_min⁶ = 23ħcR⁶cm²/(4πGm²T), namely (·)^{1/6}.
Explicit spectral decomposition of the phase-free core of ρ^{T_B} (Γ_A = Γ_B): eigenvalues (1+p²±2p cos(Δφ/2))/4 and (1−p²±2p sin(Δφ/2))/4 with explicit eigenvectors, p = e^{−x}.
assumptions: none (polynomial identity in c, s, p)

theorems.informal_statement: Exact PPT criterion: for any real phase table and any x, ρ^{T_B} (x_A = x_B = x) is PSD iff 2e^{−x}|sin(Δφ/2)| ≤ 1 − e^{−2x} (equivalently |sin(Δφ/2)| ≤ sinh x).
If |Δφ| ≤ 2x then ρ^{T_B} is PSD (the state is PPT).

Time-dependent threshold: if Δφ(0) = 0, Δφ is differentiable on t ≥ 0 and |dΔφ/dt| ≤ 2Γ for all t ≥ 0, then for every t ≥ 0 the state with Γ_A = Γ_B = Γ (x = Γt) has PSD partial transpose (PPT). This is the Γ ≥ |dΔφ/dt|/2 criterion of entanglement_dephasing_threshold, stated as PPT.

Every separable two-qubit matrix (in the sense of IsSeparable) has positive semidefinite partial transpose (separable ⇒ PPT). IsSeparable ρ :≡ ∃ finite index set ι, weights w_k ≥ 0 with Σ w_k = 1, and 2×2 density matrices (PSD, trace 1) ρA_k, ρB_k with ρ = Σ_k w_k • (ρA_k ⊗ ρB_k).
ρ(a) = ½(1 + a·σ) is a density matrix (PSD, trace 1) whenever a_x²+a_y²+a_z² ≤ 1.
Explicit 8-term product-state ensemble: Σ_{τ,ε,η=±1} (1+τc)/8 · ρ(τp, εA, ηA) ⊗ ρ(τp, ηB, εB) equals the phase-free core state with real part ¼p^{[i≠k]+[j≠l]}(1−n²+n²c) and imaginary part −n·A·B/4.
The phase-free core with parameters p > 0, c²+s² = 1 is separable whenever 2p|s| ≤ 1−p² (A = √((1−p²)/2), B = −ps/A).
dephasedState φ x x = (U_β ⊗ U_γ) · core(e^{−x}, cos(Δφ/2), e^{−x} sin(Δφ/2)) · (U_β ⊗ U_γ)† with local diagonal phase unitaries U_r = diag(e^{irz_i}).
assumptions: φ = phaseModel α β γ δ

theorems.informal_statement: For any real phase table and any x (x_A = x_B = x): the dephased BMV state is separable ⇔ 2e^{−x}|sin(Δφ/2)| ≤ 1 − e^{−2x}. IsSeparable ρ :≡ ∃ finite index set ι, weights w_k ≥ 0 with Σ w_k = 1, and 2×2 density matrices (PSD, trace 1) ρA_k, ρB_k with ρ = Σ_k w_k • (ρA_k ⊗ ρB_k).
For the dephased BMV family (x_A = x_B = x, any phases): separable ⇔ ρ^{T_B} PSD (PPT ⇔ separable, proved directly for this family without general Peres–Horodecki).
Separable ⇔ |sin(Δφ/2)| ≤ sinh x.
If Δφ(0) = 0 and |dΔφ/dt| ≤ 2Γ on t ≥ 0 (Δφ differentiable there), then for every t ≥ 0 the state with x_A = x_B = Γt is separable.
If Δφ(t) = ωt for all t and Γ < |ω|/2 (any real ω, Γ), there exists t > 0 at which ρ^{T_B} (x = Γt) is not PSD and the state is not separable (entangled).
For Δφ(t) = ωt and constant Γ (x = Γt): the state is separable at every t ≥ 0 ⇔ Γ ≥ |ω|/2. The threshold Γ* = |ω|/2 is exact.
